TITLE: SUNROOM LINE
SHELL_MATERIAL_COLOR: Translucent honey-amber and butter-yellow plastic with cloudy cream internal ribs and a small faded sky-blue grip accent. Friendly molded toy plastic with simple soft highlights, not polished glass or metal.
SHAPE_LANGUAGE: A compact, chunky cartridge with softly rounded corners, a gently domed top, and two broad rounded shoulders reminiscent of a small tram's front. A generous front label is framed by a simple raised rim. Keep it clearly a retro cartridge rather than a miniature vehicle, fully visible in the frame.
MOTIFS_GROOVES_SURFACE_DETAILS: Two parallel shallow rail grooves run around the lower edge. A simple unlettered sunburst is embossed into one shoulder, and a few rounded rectangular recesses along the top suggest tram windows. The blue side grip has broad horizontal ridges. Use only a few large readable molded details.
OBJECT_MOOD: Genuinely safe, warm, tender, and hopeful; the comforting favourite cartridge you would lend to a friend. A pale peach studio gradient complements the amber shell.
LABEL_SCENE_DESCRIPTION: A small butter-yellow tram waits at an empty hillside station above a soft sea of peach clouds. Its open door spills a bright amber rectangle onto the platform. White daisies, oversized sunflowers, a blue wooden bench, and a striped awning sit beneath an apricot sunset. Rounded green hills emerge from the clouds. The tram destination board reads HOME, small and secondary. Use low-poly scenery, soft old-game bloom, and warm golden dust motes. The exact title SUNROOM LINE is large and simple in warm cream lettering with a sky-blue shadow in a clear upper area, without obscuring the welcoming open tram door.
